defect_observations.observation: Stale locators. The unit records body sha256 5885f5bb... and annex sha256 3fddcca4..., but the files now hash cb5c3355... (382 lines) and b0785ebd... (741 lines). Every body_lines range from C004 on and every declared_proof_destinations line is offset, for example C008 body 159-171 is now 170-182 and its annex proof moved from line 274 to 279. C020's exact_current_text no longer matches, because a clause was added at body lines 366-368. Packet work/waves/w02b/packets/w02b-p15-007.json section 159.4 reader_evidence carries the same old hashes and line ends (369/736). Content is not affected; the records need refreshing.

The C008 boundary sentence (the nesting hypothesis is essential) has no cross-reference to its witness, thm:p15-conditional-examples item 1 (body 355-361, annex 703-720). The witness exists and proves the claim, but a reader of the tower theorem has to find it unaided. A cref would fix this.

The limsup direction of conditional dominated convergence is a single sentence ('Applying Fatou to Y-X_n likewise gives ...'). It names the sequence, the lemma and the conclusion, and the finiteness needed for the subtraction is stated just before (lines 155-157), so I judged it written rather than a 'similarly' omission. Displaying the mirror inequality would remove any doubt.

The source's geometric reading (Durrett p. 213: E(X|F) is the projection of X onto L2(F)) is supplied in substance by orthogonality and the closest-point identity, but no reader-visible sentence names C_G X as the orthogonal projection. The word appears only in labels and in the annex phrase 'H-projection identity' (annex line 569). This is wording only.

C021 says the next chapter 'constructs one probability kernel ..., then proves the integration formula'. In regular-conditional-laws.tex the integration formula (thm:p15-kernel-expectation, lines 55-67) comes before the construction (lines 72-110). The order wording is inaccurate; nothing is missing.
